items.name: Enghumleblom
items.observations: Drooping reddish-purple sepals with pale rose-apricot petals; finely hairy reddish flowering stalks; multiple nodding buds; v2 basal foliage has visibly separate toothed lateral leaflets and larger lobed terminal leaflets rather than the v1 oversized unsegmented leaf blades. Brown rhizome crown and fibrous roots shown illustratively.
items.limitations: This AI-generated rendering remains a field-guide aid, not taxonomic evidence. Leaflet proportions and phyllotaxis are stylized; some flowers and floral appendages are exaggerated to improve readability. Roots are illustrative. Final human botanical comparison and publication tests are required before registering this as approved.
items.technicalVerification: Source transparent RGBA 1024x1536 converted to lossily compressed WebP with alpha; SHA256/Git blob SHA and sizes calculated directly from final bytes; light/dark previews created locally.
